summary: The general support inequality handles the diagonal and degenerate endpoints correctly. Frozen hashes and the inspected source hash match. No mathematical revision is required by this focused check.

checks.scope: Support inequality, rank-zero and diagonal endpoints
checks.method: Read SupportBound.lean, reconstructed the double count, and exhaustively checked all 51 reflexively intersecting uniform families on four points, ranks zero through four, at maximum degree and maximum degree plus two.
checks.observation: The ordered-pair identity includes mr diagonal incidences and at least m(m-1) off-diagonal incidences, giving m(m+r-1). The pointwise upper inequality is equivalent to (d-1)(D-d)>=0. Rank zero forces the family empty under reflexive intersection, so both sides vanish; D=0 likewise forces empty support. The bounded diagnostic found no violation and verified the exact squared-degree identity. It supplements the general argument and does not establish universal coverage by enumeration.
